content.storyline: The matchup brings together the AFC South-leading Jaguars and NFC East-leading Giants. Both enter with winning records: Jacksonville at 7-2 and New York at 5-3-1.
matchup_notes: Jacksonville entered 7-2 atop the AFC South, while New York entered 5-3-1 atop the NFC East.
The Jaguars had won three consecutive games entering Week 11.
The Giants lost to Washington 24-21 in Week 10.
